Based on the Endorsement Licensing and Co-Branding Agreement, revenue is shared through royalties based on **Net Sales**, subject to guaranteed minimum payments, as follows:

---

### **1. Royalty Percentage (10% of Net Sales)**
* **Licensed Products:** MusclePharm must pay Lender a **10% royalty** on the Net Sales of Licensed Products sold through wholesale or retail Distribution Channels during the term and any sell-off period (*Section 7(a)(i), Page 8*).
* **Training Video & Related Products:** If Endorser agrees to produce the Training Video, Lender receives a **10% royalty** on Net Sales of the Training Video and on Net Sales of any Products (other than Licensed Products) featured and sold directly in conjunction with the Training Video (*Section 4(a)(ii), Page 4; Section 7(a)(i), Page 8*).
* **Promotional Products:** If MusclePharm sells Promotional Products above its cost, Endorser is entitled to receive **10% of Net Sales** from such sales (otherwise, if sold at cost, no additional compensation is due) (*Section 4(e), Page 5*).

---

### **2. Definition and Calculation of "Net Sales"**
* **Net Sales** means gross sales (the gross invoice amount billed to customers) of the Licensed Products, less:
  * Discounts and allowances actually shown on the invoice (up to an aggregate maximum of 5% in any reporting cycle, excluding cash discounts, transportation costs, and commissions); and
  * Bona fide returns (not to exceed 5% in any reporting cycle) (*Section 7(a)(i), Page 8*).
* **Excluded Deductions:** No other costs incurred in manufacturing, selling, advertising, and distribution, nor any uncollectible accounts, allowances, or bad debt may be deducted (*Section 7(a)(i), Page 8*).
* **Affiliate Sales:** If sold to an affiliate at less than regular price, royalties are computed based on the regular price charged to third parties (*Section 7(a)(iii), Page 8*).

---

### **3. Guaranteed Minimum Royalties**
Lender is entitled to receive a **Guaranteed Minimum Royalty** for each Contract Year, paid in three installments (July 23, October 1, and February 1), regardless of sales (*Section 7(a)(viii), Page 9; Exhibit C, Pages 30–32*):

* **Initial Term:**
  * **Contract Year 1:** $1,500,000 (three payments of $500,000)
  * **Contract Year 2:** $2,000,000 (three payments of $666,666.66)
  * **Contract Year 3:** $2,500,000 (three payments of $833,333.33)
* **First Additional Term (if renewed):**
  * **Contract Years 4, 5, and 6:** $2,500,000 per year (three payments of $833,333.33 per year)
* **Second Additional Term (if renewed):**
  * **Contract Years 7, 8, and 9:** $5,000,000 per year (three payments of $1,666,666.66 per year)

---

### **4. Payment Timing**
* Royalties are paid quarterly in U.S. dollars within thirty (30) days following the end of each calendar quarter ending in September, December, March, and June, accompanied by an itemized certified statement (*Section 7(a)(v), Page 8*).

---

*(Note: In addition to revenue-based cash royalties, Lender was issued 780,000 restricted shares of MusclePharm stock upon execution under Section 8(a), Page 9).*
